rules: Use astrology as title doorway only, not literal zodiac symbols.
Put readable handwritten text in upper-middle negative space.
Let the eye travel from text to one clear couple action.
Use repeated decision objects lightly: planner, keys, phone, screenshots.

scene_evidence_director.note: Every slide has a drawable Aachu/Zuv behavior receipt.

romance_blocking_director.note: The emotional obstacle is tempo mismatch; the answer is mutual usefulness.

typography_and_aspect_director.note: Proof slide text is longer than ideal; use upper-middle text block, couple lower third, no face overlap.

generation_prompt_director.note: Slide 1 proof prompt must use selected visible identity references and Observational Intimacy style.

harsh_visual_selector.why: The selected system proves the locked copy through relationship action and avoids generic zodiac art.

why_it_wins: It turns a zodiac contrast into a staged relationship engine: he prepares, she begins, and the image carries the story without needing symbols.
rejected_visual_patterns: literal zodiac wheel, ram, goat, fire/earth symbols
quote-card text with tiny couple below
one cafe/table scene repeated across all slides
Aachu as reckless chaos or Zuv as passive saint

typography_and_aspect_plan.instagram_post_4_5: Text in upper-middle 38-45% of canvas, couple lower/middle-lower, brandmark bottom-right.
typography_and_aspect_plan.reels_stories_9_16: Text in upper third, couple lower half, keep extra vertical breathing room; generate separately.

open_doubts: Built-in image generation may not guarantee perfect text rendering or identity likeness on first proof.
downstream_requirements: Do not batch-generate finals until proof passes creator approval.
Use selected actual identity references and style reference context for all final prompts.
